meta_description: Gas 247 Ltd provides emergency plumbing and gas services across Newcastle. Fast response, Gas Safe registered, available day and night. Call for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — 24/7 Emergency Plumber Newcastle
hero_subhead: Burst pipe, boiler breakdown, or gas leak — we respond fast across Newcastle, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Gas Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to boiler installations, Gas 247 Ltd covers every plumbing and gas need for Newcastle homeowners and landlords.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, and plumbing failures dealt with fast — any time of day or night. We aim to be with you within 60 minutes anywhere in Newcastle.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Our Gas Safe engineers diagnose and repair all major boiler brands quickly and safely. Regular servicing keeps your boiler running efficiently and helps prevent costly breakdowns.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: We supply and fit new energy-efficient boilers tailored to your property's heating demands. All installations are fully certified and comply with current Gas Safe regulations.

services.title: Gas Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Suspect a gas leak? Call us immediately — our engineers locate and seal leaks swiftly to keep your home safe. We carry detection equipment on every van.

services.title: Central Heating Installation & Repair
services.desc: From cold radiators and faulty thermostats to full central heating system installs, we restore warmth to your home with minimum disruption.

services.title: Landlord Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: We issue CP12 Gas Safety certificates to meet your legal obligations as a landlord. Inspections are thorough, fully documented, and completed at a time that suits you and your tenants.

about_pullquote: We show up when it matters most — no excuses, no delays.
about_para_1: Gas 247 Ltd was founded in Newcastle upon Tyne with one clear purpose: to give local homeowners and landlords access to a genuinely reliable emergency plumbing and gas service around the clock. Operating from our base in NE5, our Gas Safe registered engineers cover all areas of Newcastle and the surrounding region.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is simple — we answer the phone at 3am just as readily as we do at 9am, and we treat every job with the same level of care and professionalism. Our customers return to us because we are honest about costs upfront, tidy in our work, and reliable when emergencies strike.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service. Called Gas 247 at midnight with a burst pipe and the engineer was at my door within the hour. Sorted everything quickly and was completely professional throughout. Would not hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Had a suspected gas leak and was quite worried. Gas 247 answered straight away, arrived fast, and had the problem identified and fixed in no time. Brilliant peace of mind knowing there's a reliable local company like this on hand.
reviews.author: Michael R.

reviews.text: Used Gas 247 for my annual landlord gas safety certificate. Really straightforward process, turned up on time, gave a clear report, and the price was very fair. Will be booking them again next year without question.
reviews.author: James P.
